hijack_scenarioMomentumDumping.reason: upstream setup carries a sun third body + SPICE ephemeris (createBodies('earth','sun')); the mirror requires exactly the central body and the env-bodies N-body path is an honest NO-GO (list.md A1: stock-reader loud raise + ~2.4 km central-J2 shadow divergence). Dropping the sun would silently diverge the arms by sun-tide order (~6 cm over the leg), so no hijack until the N-body path goes green. Covered by the central-earth bench cell demo_momentumDumping (both arms share the adapted setup).
